verdicts.reason: A gets the hierarchy backwards. The 'Sunset Sessions' headline is pushed into a small slot on the right, while the subtitle in the middle is much bigger. The date text is jammed against the left edge, the tags are stacked into a tall column, the logo is shrunk to a tiny strip under the product, and the image-placeholder box sits under the RSVP button, so the reading order is jumbled. B correctly makes the headline the centred focal point with the date beneath it, but its 'RSVP Free' button is shrunk to the same size as the tags and butts right up against them, so the call to action is buried. B's right-hand subtitle and left-hand time/venue text are also tiny and cramped, and its placeholder box collides with the end of the tag row.
